CWC
FORM NO. 3
G. 651-39

CONFIDENTIAL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
S. 1, Special Branch Station
REPORT
Date October 26, 19 39. 37

Subject (in full) Fritz SCHICK, German.

Made by D.S. Pitts Forwarded by C Crawford

D.
〔此处有一枚椭圆形印章，内容大致为 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH，中间有手写数字，因模糊难以完全辨认〕

Czecho.-Slovakian Passport No. 87/36 was issued to one Fritz SCHICK in Shanghai on July 18, 1936. The registration papers relating to this passport are now in the hands of the German Consulate-General by whom SCHICK is regarded as a German national. No further details can be secured from these sources.

As far as our records show, nobody named SCHICK was connected in any way with General Von SEECKT during the latter's stay in China as Military Adviser to the Nationalist Government.

In view of the fact that all official Czecho-slovakian affairs have been taken over by the German Consulate-General, it has not been deemed advisable to press the enquiry too far in order to avoid any possible embarrassing questioning.

Jo. Pitts.
D. S.

D. C.(Special Branch).

日期：1939年10月26日。37

主题（全称）弗里茨·席克（Fritz SCHICK），德国人。

制作人：D.S. 皮茨（Pitts） 转呈人：C. 克劳福德（Crawford）

D.
〔此处有一枚椭圆形印章，内容大致为 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH，中间有手写数字，因模糊难以完全辨认〕

捷克斯洛伐克护照第87/36号于1936年7月18日在上海签发给一名叫弗里茨·席克（Fritz SCHICK）的人。与该护照相关的登记文件现由德国总领事馆保管，该馆视席克为德国国民。从这些来源无法获取更多详情。

据我方记录显示，在冯·塞克特将军（General Von SEECKT）担任国民政府军事顾问在华期间，没有任何名为席克（SCHICK）的人与其有任何关联。

鉴于所有官方捷克斯洛伐克事务已由德国总领事馆接管，为避免任何可能令人尴尬的质询，认为不宜过分深究此事。

乔·皮茨（Jo. Pitts）。
D. S.

D. C.（特务科）。

October 17th, 1939.

Would it be possible to discover
whether a Czechoslovakian passport
No: 87/36 was issued in Shanghai on
July 18th, 1936, to a certain FRITZ
SCHICK?

（批：? 81/36）

是否有可能查明，
1936年7月18日，
一张捷克斯洛伐克护照
编号：87/36，
是否在上海签发给了
某位弗里茨·席克（FRITZ SCHICK）？

（批注：? 81/36）

pages.en:
FRITZ SHICK passenger Denbighshire believed to have
false passport (Czecho-Slovakian) obtained in Shanghai 1936.
He is reported to have arrived Shanghai 1937 as
assistant to General Von SICHT.

81/42
D.S. Olls

pages.zh:
弗里茨·席克（FRITZ SHICK），“登比郡”号（Denbighshire）乘客，据信持有1936年在上海获得的伪造（捷克斯洛伐克）护照。
据报道，他于1937年抵达上海，身份是冯·西希特将军（General Von SICHT）的助手。

81/42
D.S. 奥尔斯（Olls）
